text:
nora_g: Hi team — was in Lisbon on travel and had to go to urgent care. Paid in EUR, got a receipt, and I don't have my physical insurance card with me. Can I get a temporary/electronic ID and how do I file the out-of-network claim?

maria_peopleops: Sorry you had to use urgent care. You can get a temporary electronic ID PDF right away. Also for OON claims: upload the original receipt + English translation + proof of payment to the benefits portal under 'Out-of-country medical claims'.

ben_hr_ops: Nora, I can email the e-ID to your work address now. Send me the patient name as listed on the claim and I'll include member ID and plan name in the PDF.

nora_g: Patient name is Nora Green. Plan is Redwood Standard. Receipt is EUR 65, date 2026-03-15. Need the PDF for the clinic if they ask.

ben_hr_ops: Sending e-ID PDF to nora.g@redwood.com now. It contains a scannable member number and coverage dates.

claims_bot: Note: For out-of-country claims we need itemized receipt, a quick English translation (one line ok), and a bank/cc statement image showing payment. Processing 10-15 business days after complete docs.

nora_g: The receipt is in Portuguese and shows 'consulta' + 'medicação'. I can type a short translation. Also do you accept currency conversion screenshots or should I let you do conversion?

maria_peopleops: You don't need to convert. Upload the original receipt and select 'foreign currency' in the portal; claims team will use the official conversion rate on the service date. Your one-line translation is fine.

nora_g: Uploaded receipt_lisbon.pdf, translation.txt, payment_stmt.png. Tagged @maria_peopleops in the portal.

claims_bot: Claim OC-2026-578 created. Expedited triage not available for standard urgent care; normal timeline applies. We'll notify you if anything's missing.

maria_peopleops: All set from our side. Ben, confirm sent?

ben_hr_ops: Confirmed PDF sent. Nora, if the clinic needs printed proof, you can print the PDF or show on your phone. Let us know if claim team asks for additional documents.

nora_g: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.
